# Our Team
<div class="section-divider"></div>

We are a five-member team collaborating on the CitiBike analysis project.  
Each member contributed to different aspects of data processing, spatial/temporal analysis,  
website development, and report writing.

---

<div class="section-divider"></div>

### **Jingfeng Cao (jc6693)**
- Focus: Temporal pattern analysis  
- Contributions: Hour-of-day + month-level visualizations, summary tables   

### **Renxuan Deng (rd3228)**

### **Zizhi Xia (zx2528)**

### **Fei Xue (fx2206)**

### **Xirui Yang (xy2672)**
